'''2000 Indiana State Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG state championship held in Indiana in spring 2000. [[Matthew Wright]] posted the X-wing deck he played there, which went 2–1, "losing only to the winner of states".<ref name="dt-5925">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/5925 x-wing deck from indiana states], DeckTech (Matthew "Teknologik" Wright, 24 April 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/5925/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/5925/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Dates:''' 2000 (before 24 April)
* '''Site:''' Indiana
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
